siteFacts.source: Live fetch of artofliving.org pages and robots.txt / llms.txt on 2026-11-14

facts.finding: No meta description on the Canada home page (og:description is empty too).
facts.plain: Our Canada home page has no short summary for search engines and chatbots to show.

facts.finding: Could not confirm any schema.org JSON-LD (the fetcher strips scripts). Course and Event schema were not visible.
facts.plain: Our course pages don't clearly label course details (name, level, place) in the way chatbots read.

facts.finding: No FAQ section on the home or programs pages.
facts.plain: Our main pages have no 'common questions' section, which chatbots love to quote.

facts.finding: Program listing shows no format, duration or price, which are the facts AI answers quote.
facts.plain: Our course list doesn't say how long a course is, whether it's online, or what it costs. Those are the facts chatbots repeat.

facts.finding: llms.txt exists but is US-centric (about 80 KB), lists only one Canadian entry (/ca-en/) and appears truncated mid-link.
facts.plain: The guide file we provide for AI tools mostly lists US pages and only one Canadian link.

facts.finding: robots.txt has no rules blocking GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot or Google-Extended, so AI crawlers are allowed. Good.
facts.plain: Good news: we don't block AI tools from reading our website.

facts.finding: Search results show Canadian pages with slug-like titles such as "i 504", "home 4", "global project template", "events old" and "service individual 0". Stale or test pages are indexed and dilute the real ones.
facts.plain: Old or test pages with names like 'i 504' and 'home 4' show up in search and crowd out our real pages.

facts.finding: /ca-en/sky-breath-meditation, /ca-en/art-living-part-1 and /ca-en/centers return client errors for automated fetchers.
facts.plain: Some Canadian pages, like the centres list, don't open for automated readers.

facts.finding: Art of Living Vancouver already has an Eventbrite organizer page, but it did not appear for 'breathwork class Vancouver' or 'best meditation course Vancouver'.
facts.plain: Vancouver already has an Eventbrite page, but it doesn't come up when people search for breathwork or beginner meditation there. Event titles need the words people actually type.

facts.finding: Every unbranded question where Art of Living appeared was in a city with its own centre page (Markham, Richmond Hill, Kitchener-Waterloo, Sherbrooke, Toronto) or matched a retreat listing on Retreat Guru.
facts.plain: Good news: where we have a centre page for that city, or a listing on a booking site, we do come up. That shows the fixes work.

items.question: Where can I learn meditation in Canada?
items.answer: The Art of Living Foundation teaches meditation in Canada and online across Canada. Beginners usually start with Art of Living Part 1 or the Introductory Workshop; Sahaj Samadhi Meditation teaches a mantra-based practice.

items.question: Are there breathwork classes in Canada?
items.answer: Yes. Art of Living Part 1 teaches SKY Breath Meditation (Sudarshan Kriya), a rhythmic breathing technique, in Canada and online. Graduates join weekly Sudarshan Kriya Follow-ups to practise together.

items.question: Is there a breathing course for anxiety or stress in Canada?
items.answer: Deep Sleep & Anxiety Relief is a short program of breathing and relaxation practices for anxiety and sleep. Art of Living Part 1 goes deeper with SKY Breath Meditation, and SKY has been studied in peer-reviewed research on stress and anxiety.

items.question: Is there a breathing program to help me sleep better?
items.answer: Deep Sleep & Anxiety Relief teaches breathing and relaxation techniques for deeper sleep, online or in person across Canada.

items.question: Is there a meditation program for university students in Canada?
items.answer: SKY Campus (university and college) runs SKY breathing and meditation workshops at Canadian universities and colleges. Teens can take SKY Teens (YES! program).

items.question: Where can I do a silent meditation retreat in Canada?
items.answer: Art of Living Part 2 is a silence retreat with deeper meditations for people who have completed Art of Living Part 1. Retreats are hosted at the Art of Living Canada Centre in Saint-Mathieu-du-Parc, Québec.

items.question: Is there a live online meditation course in Canada?
items.answer: Art of Living Part 1 is offered online with a live Art of Living teacher as well as in person. Upcoming dates are listed at https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/find/course.

items.question: Is there a free or intro meditation session in Canada?
items.answer: The Introductory Workshop is a short session to try a breathing technique and a guided meditation before a full course, in Canada and online.

# The Art of Living Foundation Canada

> Non-profit teaching meditation, breathwork (SKY Breath Meditation / Sudarshan Kriya) and yoga across Canada, in person and online, in English and French.

Contact: +1-800-983-3886. Head office and retreat centre: 13 Chem. de l'Infinité, Saint-Mathieu-du-Parc, QC.

## Programs
- [Art of Living Part 1](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/art-of-living-part-one): Breath and meditation course built around SKY / Sudarshan Kriya, a rhythmic breathing technique, with guided meditation and practical wisdom for daily stress. (First Steps)
- [Sahaj Samadhi Meditation](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/sahaj-samadhi-meditation): Mantra-based meditation, given personally to each participant, for effortless daily practice. (First Steps)
- [Art of Living Part 2](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/art-of-living-part-two): Silence retreat with deeper meditations, mudras and pranayamas, for people who have done Part 1. (First Steps)
- [Deep Sleep & Anxiety Relief](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/deep-sleep-and-anxiety): Short protocol of breathing and relaxation practices aimed at better sleep and relief from anxiety. (Entry Level)
- [Introductory Workshop](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/intro-talk): Introductory session to experience a breathing technique and guided meditation before taking a full course. (Entry Level)
- [Sri Sri Yoga](https://www.artofliving.org/ca-en/courses/sri-sri-yoga): Yoga course combining postures, breathing and meditation. (Entry Level)

items.question: Où apprendre la méditation au Québec ?
items.answer: La Fondation Art de Vivre enseigne la méditation au Québec et en ligne partout au Canada. Les débutants commencent souvent par Art of Living Part 1 ou par l'Introductory Workshop.

items.question: Y a-t-il des cours de respiration (breathwork) au Québec ?
items.answer: Oui. Art of Living Part 1 enseigne la méditation SKY (Sudarshan Kriya), une technique de respiration rythmée. Les participants peuvent ensuite pratiquer en groupe chaque semaine.

items.question: Existe-t-il un atelier de respiration contre le stress ou l’anxiété ?
items.answer: Deep Sleep & Anxiety Relief propose des techniques de respiration et de relaxation pour l'anxiété et le sommeil. Art of Living Part 1 va plus loin avec la méditation SKY, étudiée dans des recherches publiées sur le stress et l'anxiété.

items.question: Où faire une retraite de méditation en silence au Québec ?
items.answer: Art of Living Part 2 est une retraite en silence offerte au Centre Art de Vivre Canada, à Saint-Mathieu-du-Parc en Mauricie, pour les personnes ayant suivi Art of Living Part 1.
